querySettings.queryModeTooltip:
Select the retrieval strategy:
• Naive: Traditional text chunk vector retrieval
• Local: Focus on entity retrieval
• Global: Focus on relationship retrieval
• Hybrid: Local+Global
• Mix: Local+Global+Naive
• Bypass: Skip retrieval, send conversation history and current question to LLM
querySettings.responseFormatTooltip:
Defines the response format. Examples:
• Multiple Paragraphs
• Single Paragraph
• Bullet Points
querySettings.topKTooltip: Number of entities and relations to retrieve. Applicable for non-naive modes.
querySettings.chunkTopKTooltip: Number of text chunks to retrieve, applicable for all modes.
querySettings.maxEntityTokensTooltip: Maximum number of tokens allocated for entity context in unified token control system
querySettings.maxRelationTokensTooltip: Maximum number of tokens allocated for relationship context in unified token control system
querySettings.maxTotalTokensTooltip: Maximum total tokens budget for the entire query context (entities + relations + chunks + system prompt)
querySettings.historyTurnsTooltip: Number of complete conversation turns (user-assistant pairs) to consider in the response context
querySettings.onlyNeedContextTooltip: If True, only returns the retrieved context without generating a response

querySettings.streamResponseTooltip: If True, enables streaming output for real-time responses
querySettings.userPromptTooltip: Provide additional response requirements to the LLM (unrelated to query content, only for output processing).
querySettings.enableRerankTooltip: Enable reranking for retrieved text chunks. If True but no rerank model is configured, a warning will be issued. Default is True.

desc.extract: Reads each chunk of a document and pulls out entities and relationships, then merges them into the graph.

desc.keyword: Turns each question into search keywords before looking in the graph.
desc.query: Writes the answer from what retrieval found. It is usually the most expensive purpose per token.

setting.EXTRACT_LLM_MODEL: The model. Falls back to LLM_MODEL when not set.
setting.MAX_GLEANING: Extra passes over each chunk. Lower saves tokens but may miss entities.
setting.CHUNK_SIZE: Larger chunks mean fewer calls but bigger prompts.
setting.FORCE_LLM_SUMMARY_ON_MERGE: How many descriptions it takes to trigger a summary.
setting.ENABLE_LLM_CACHE_FOR_EXTRACT: Reuses earlier results when a document is reprocessed.
setting.VLM_LLM_MODEL: The model. It must support images.
setting.VLM_PROCESS_ENABLE: Turns vision on or off for documents and emails.
setting.VLM_MIN_IMAGE_PIXEL: Skips tiny images, in documents and emails.
setting.VLM_MAX_IMAGE_BYTES: Largest image sent, in documents and emails.
setting.KEYWORD_LLM_MODEL: The model. A small, fast one is usually enough.
setting.ENABLE_LLM_CACHE: Reuses the result when the same question is asked again.
setting.QUERY_LLM_MODEL: The model. Usually the largest cost decision.
setting.MAX_TOTAL_TOKENS: Upper limit on context for each answer.
setting.TOP_K: How many entities and relationships are retrieved.
setting.CHUNK_TOP_K: How many text chunks are kept.

unavailable.body: The Operations views need PostgreSQL KV storage (LIGHTRAG_KV_STORAGE=PGKVStorage). This server uses a different KV storage, so the views will stay empty. The server itself is not affected.

paused.label: Paused
paused.explain: The LLM provider rejected requests (for example budget or rate limit). The run resumes when the pause clears.

hung.label: Hung
hung.explain: The worker is alive but no document has made progress for longer than the hung threshold.

orphaned.label: Orphaned
orphaned.explain: The worker that owned this run has exited. Busy stays set until it is released.

busy_without_run.label: Busy without a run
busy_without_run.explain: The workspace is marked busy but no live run owns it, for example after an upgrade or a crash.

reservation.label: Stranded reservation
reservation.explain: A scan or enqueue reservation has no live owner and blocks email drains. Restart the container to clear it.

stale_doc.label: Stale document
stale_doc.explain: The document has been in progress for longer than the stale-document threshold.

unresponsive.label: Unresponsive
unresponsive.explain: The worker process exists but has stopped sending heartbeats.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.explain: The state of this run could not be determined.

error.forbidden: Admin access required. Your session may lack the admin role.
error.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
error.not_found: Not found. The server may be running an older version.
error.conflict: The state changed in the meantime. Refresh and try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
error.unavailable: The service is unavailable. A dependency may be down.
error.refCopyFailed: Could not copy the request ID

refusal.in_progress_by: Another admin is already acting on this workspace.
refusal.lock_unavailable: The workspace lock could not be taken within 2 seconds. If it stays held, restart the container.
refusal.refused_paused: Refused: a provider pause is active.
refusal.not_busy: Nothing to cancel: the pipeline is not busy.
refusal.nothing_pending: Nothing is waiting in the email queue.
refusal.owner_alive: Refused: the worker that owns the run is still alive.
refusal.cas_mismatch: The run changed since you looked. Refresh and try again.
refusal.single_process: Not available when the server runs as a single process.
refusal.rate_limited: Too soon. Wait a minute and try again.
refusal.feature_disabled: This action is turned off on this server.

system.title: This server
system.workersPending: Reported once worker heartbeats are available

later.note: This section arrives in a later release.

overview.title: System overview
overview.body: The overall state, key numbers, a needs-attention list, the last 6 hours of processing and a dependency summary will appear here.

processing.title: Processing across workspaces
processing.body: Active runs, stuck runs and documents, the backlog by workspace, failure analysis, the email re-sync queue and provider pauses will appear here. Until then, the Documents tab shows the pipeline of your own workspace.

logs.title: Logs
logs.body: A searchable view of WARNING and ERROR log lines, redacted when they are written, will appear here. Error messages already show a Ref: request ID that matches the server log line.

health.title: Health
health.body: Dependency checks (PostgreSQL, the graph and vector stores, vLLM, Docling, SMTP and sign-in), a topology map and worker heartbeats will appear here. Until then, the status indicator at the bottom right shows this server's configuration and queues.

performance.title: Performance
performance.body: LLM, embedding and rerank latency, HTTP routes, throughput and concurrency will appear here. Token use and cost stay in Token Insights.

activity.title: Activity
activity.body: Alerts, the audit log of admin actions, system events and incident export will appear here.
